This strategic realignment follows today’s topline readout from the Phase 3 LUCIA study of DURAVYU in wet AMD, which did not meet its primary endpoint of non-inferiority, despite vision improvements, and despite meeting key secondary endpoints including reduction in treatment burden, supplement-free rates, anatomic control, and safety with redosing.
EyePoint plans to prioritize the development of DURAVYU for the potential treatment of DME, which is expected to read out pivotal Phase 3 topline data in the fourth quarter of 2027.

Key Financial & Operational Updates · Cash Conservation: The strategic prioritization and associated operational adjustments are expected to generate estimated annualized savings of approximately $30 million. · Workforce Reduction: Impacting approximately 53% of positions across the organization, with the substantial majority of the workforce reduction expected to occur during the fourth quarter of 2026 and to be completed during the first half of 2027. · Clinical Prioritization: Organization focused on the clinical development of DURAVYU for the potential treatment of DME with an upcoming pivotal Phase 3 readout in two trials expected in the fourth quarter of 2027. · One-Time Charges: The Company estimates it will incur aggregate charges of approximately $9 million related to employee separation benefits, including employee severance and other related expenses.
